dust_wisp.name: Dust Wisp
dust_wisp.folklore: Hitodama / will-o'-the-wisp style ghost-lights (Celtic & Japanese; general folklore, GK).
dust_wisp.role: Tutorial skirmisher: dies in 1-2 hits, teaches Shift (weak Flame Near / Lumen Far).

moss_slimeling.name: Moss Slimeling
moss_slimeling.folklore: Original (shrine-moss blob; closest folklore: nuppeppo-style formless yokai, GK).
moss_slimeling.role: Teaches elements: Flame wins, Tide fails.

bond.name: Moss Cushion
bond.passive: Regen 3% max HP after each battle (field).

straw_hound.name: Straw Hound
straw_hound.folklore: Scarecrow/straw-effigy dog; Celtic black-dog omen (barghest) flavour (GK). Bakemono Zoshi has scarecrow yokai [Wikipedia Tsukumogami].
straw_hound.role: First fast enemy; Far form is a spirit hound (Phys x0.75).

hollow_villager.name: Hollow Villager
hollow_villager.folklore: Hollowed = forgotten dead (Spirited Away name-loss theme; FFX pyreflies idea) [design bible 4.2].
hollow_villager.role: First Hollowed. Send gives a Name Fragment; killing gives full EXP but no Fragment.

well_newt.name: Wellkeeper Newt
well_newt.folklore: Original; wells as thresholds (Old Well). Closest: idobake-style well lore (GK).
well_newt.role: Tide enemy that punishes Flame spam.

gloam_bat.name: Gloam Bat
gloam_bat.folklore: Original bat (komori); echo-location = sonar ping skill.

bond.name: Echo Ping
bond.passive: Telegraph icons show 1 turn earlier on bosses.

candle_spirit.name: Candle Spirit
candle_spirit.folklore: Original; shrine candles (tsukumogami-adjacent object spirit, GK).

bell_mouse.name: Bell Mouse
bell_mouse.folklore: Original small-object spirit; tsukumogami idea of tools gaining spirits [Wikipedia Tsukumogami].
bell_mouse.role: Support recruit that fuels skill spam.

ofuda_moth.name: Ofuda Moth
ofuda_moth.folklore: Original: paper protective charms (ofuda) come alive; paper-familiar (shikigami) idea (GK).
ofuda_moth.role: Shrine caster; Near form burns easily.

rustle_sprite.name: Rustle Sprite
rustle_sprite.folklore: Original leaf-spirit; compare kodama tree spirits [Wikipedia/Japan Objects].

mist_heron.name: Mist Heron
mist_heron.folklore: Original spirit-bird (herons are classic water-edge omen birds in Japanese art, GK).

forgotten_pilgrim.name: Forgotten Pilgrim
forgotten_pilgrim.folklore: Hollowed traveller (FFX pilgrimage / Mictlan journey motif, inspiration only) [bible 4.1].
forgotten_pilgrim.role: Sorrowful Hollowed; lost_trail induces Fading on Mio.

kodama_echo.name: Kodama Echo
kodama_echo.folklore: Kodama: tree spirits associated with echoes [Japan Objects].
kodama_echo.role: Elusive: appears only in Far Misty Grove after the party stands still 5 s; flees after 3 turns.

rusalka_reed.name: Rusalka Reed
rusalka_reed.folklore: Rusalki: water spirits, often restless dead [bible 4.1 / Slavic].
rusalka_reed.role: Crossing caster; Far form is the restless dead.

river_kappa.name: River Kappa
river_kappa.folklore: Kappa: river tricksters with a water-filled head dish [Japan Objects / Wallango].
river_kappa.role: Mini-boss precursor; cucumber is the tell.

nurikabe.name: Nurikabe
nurikabe.folklore: Nurikabe: an invisible wall that blocks travelers; striking its base dispels it [Japan Objects; crossasia Foster].
nurikabe.role: Tank: Phys resisted x0.75 in Far; Parley (Rap) is the fast solution.

willow_sprout.name: Willow Sprout
willow_sprout.folklore: Original; child of the Willow Mother (grieving tree spirit).

bond.name: Root Hold
bond.passive: DEF +1 stage while at full HP (first turn).

moss_leshy.name: Moss Leshy
moss_leshy.role: Visible elite (forest guardian). Optional; respects firmness (Rap) not flattery.

marigold_moth.name: Marigold Moth
marigold_moth.folklore: Cempasuchil (marigold) guides souls home in Dia de Muertos practice [bible 4.1 / UNESCO]; inspiration only.
marigold_moth.role: Rare guide: reduces Far Lumen drain.

bond.name: Marigold Path
bond.passive: Far battles cost 1 less Lumen per turn.

paper_lantern.name: Paper Lantern
paper_lantern.role: Realm-flip showcase: Near weak Flame, Far weak Umbra.

bond.name: Glow Burst
bond.passive: +1 Lumen per Far battle turn (cancels drain).

parasol_spirit.name: Parasol Spirit
parasol_spirit.folklore: Kasa-obake: umbrella yokai (Tsukumogami article notes its tsukumogami status is uncertain) [Wikipedia].
parasol_spirit.role: Fast gale support; speeds enemy ally turns.

drowned_clerk.name: Drowned Clerk
drowned_clerk.folklore: Faceless official (nopperabo-style faceless yokai, GK) + Lethe forgetting [bible 4.1].

night_stall_tanuki.name: Night-Stall Tanuki
night_stall_tanuki.folklore: Tanuki: mischievous shapeshifters [bible 4.1 / Wikipedia tsukumogami note on tanuki].

bakeneko.name: Bakeneko
bakeneko.folklore: Bakeneko: supernatural cats, distinct from the forked-tailed nekomata [Japan Objects / Wallango].
bakeneko.role: Survives once at 1 HP in Far.

amabie.name: Amabie
amabie.role: Elusive: appears only in Far canals when Lumen is full; flees after 2 turns.

bond.name: Prophecy
bond.passive: Boss telegraph icon shows exact skill name.

jorogumo_weaver.name: Jorogumo Weaver
jorogumo_weaver.folklore: Jorogumo: spider who becomes a beautiful woman to lure and bind men [Wallango / Japan Objects].

hitotsume_kozo.name: Hitotsume-kozo
hitotsume_kozo.role: Prankster: its reaction-bait is safe if you hold still.

bond.name: Evil Eye
bond.passive: Echo gained from weakness hits +10% chance of +1 extra.

parade_imp.name: Parade Imp
parade_imp.folklore: Hyakki Yagyo night-parade denizen (parade of yokai) [bible 4.1].

river_imp.name: River Imp
river_imp.folklore: Original water imp (kappa/kelpie flavour; kelpie = Celtic water-horse, GK).

cinder_mite.name: Cinder Mite
cinder_mite.folklore: Original; sparks of the forge (Cinder Mine).

anvil_gnome.name: Anvil Gnome
anvil_gnome.folklore: Tsukumogami: tools older than ~100 years awaken [Wikipedia Tsukumogami].

key.note: Respect a smith: a gentle knock.

kitsunebi_mote.name: Kitsunebi Mote
kitsunebi_mote.folklore: Kitsune-bi: foxfire; kitsune shapeshifting foxes linked to Inari [bible 4.1].

bond.name: Foxfire Wave
bond.passive: Kaze: SP cost of Flame skills -2.

oni_foreman.name: Oni Foreman
oni_foreman.folklore: Oni: horned ogre demons (GK); forge-boss flavour.

tengu_crow.name: Tengu Crow
tengu_crow.folklore: Tengu: winged mountain goblins (GK); pack has Tengu sprites.

anvil_spark.name: Anvil Spark
anvil_spark.folklore: Original adds for the Hundred-Year Anvil.
anvil_spark.role: Boss add: explodes if alive 2 turns.

faded_neighbor.name: Faded Neighbor
faded_neighbor.folklore: Ashiro villagers fading as names are forgotten (original; Spirited Away name motif).
faded_neighbor.role: Emotional Parley: villagers whose names Mio knows.

key.note: Mio calls their name: Calm + guaranteed Fragment.

dimmed_lantern.name: Dimmed Lantern
dimmed_lantern.folklore: Chochin that lost its light; Hollowed object (original).

memory_koi.name: Memory Koi
memory_koi.folklore: Original; memories as koi in the Memory Trail.
memory_koi.role: Rare Parley gift: improves peaceful play.

archive_moth.name: Archive Moth
archive_moth.folklore: Original; eats ink and names (Archive of Names).

name_eater.name: Name-Eater
name_eater.role: Holds a Name Fragment hostage 2 turns (Nameless).

stilled_reveler.name: Stilled Reveler
stilled_reveler.folklore: Frozen dancers of the Still Garden (original).

key.note: A song lets them finish the dance.

still_garden_statue.name: Still Garden Statue
still_garden_statue.folklore: Construct holding a spirit (original); Still Garden sealing idea.

stone_peony.name: Stone Peony
stone_peony.folklore: Original; frozen blossoms of the Still Garden.

forgetmenot_swarm.name: Forget-me-not Swarm
forgetmenot_swarm.folklore: Forget-me-not flower; a swarm of remembered petals (original).
forgetmenot_swarm.role: Swarm: Mood needed 60; Lantern Hymn calms all.

gashadokuro_bone.name: Gashadokuro
gashadokuro_bone.folklore: Gashadokuro: giant skeleton of the unburied/starved dead (GK).
gashadokuro_bone.role: Elite; needs 3 Remembers. Drops guaranteed Fragment when Sent.

garden_pillar.name: Garden Pillar
garden_pillar.folklore: Puzzle target for the Garden Guardian fight (original).

ink_serpent.name: Ink Serpent
ink_serpent.folklore: Original; ink-black serpent of the Stacks.

alebrije_pup.name: Alebrije Pup
alebrije_pup.folklore: Alebrijes: colourful folk-art creatures from Pedro Linares's fever dream, Mexico City; used by Pixar as spirit guides, not traditional Dia de Muertos [Mexico City heritage / Slate / Disney].
alebrije_pup.role: Elusive roster slot with 4 palette variants.

zashiki_child.name: Zashiki Child
zashiki_child.folklore: Zashiki-warashi: childlike household spirit that brings prosperity [Japan Objects]; domovoi/brownie hearth-spirit kin [bible 4.1].
zashiki_child.role: Never fights: appears on Kettle's inn / Ashiro Far; only Parley is available.

hearth_brownie.name: Hearth Brownie
hearth_brownie.folklore: Brownie / domovoi household spirits honoured with milk [bible 4.1 / Slavic; Celtic folklore GK].
hearth_brownie.role: Elusive: appears only at night market stalls with an unattended milk bowl.

bond.name: Hearth Ward
bond.passive: Lantern Post rest also cures Hollow Touch.

name_scrap.name: Name Scrap
name_scrap.folklore: Original adds of the Archive Echo (torn name-scraps).
name_scrap.role: Boss add: feeds the Echo when left alive.
